'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Gaza war]]
**[[Donald Trump's September 2025 Gaza Strip proposal]]
***[[Hamas]] says it has agreed to part of the 20-point plan proposed by [[President of the United States|U.S. president]] [[Donald Trump]] to end the war, including the release of [[Gaza war hostage crisis|hostages]] and handing over administration of the enclave. [https://thehill.com/policy/international/5537890-hamas-trump-peace-deal-gaza/ (''The Hill'')] [https://www.reuters.com/world/china/trump-gives-hamas-until-sunday-evening-reach-gaza-deal-2025-10-03/ (Reuters)]
***[[United Nations special rapporteur|United Nations human rights experts]] warn that multiple portions of the plan contradict international law and the [[ICJ case on Israel's occupation of the Palestinian territories|ICJ ruling]] on [[Israeli-occupied territories|Israel's occupation of Palestine]]. [https://www.ohchr.org/en/press-releases/2025/10/palestine-any-peace-plan-must-respect-international-law-beginning-self (OCHR)]
**[[Israeli bombing of the Gaza Strip]], [[2025 Gaza City offensive]]
***At least 72 [[Palestinians]] are killed from [[IDF|Israeli]] attacks across the [[Gaza Strip]], including 42 killed in [[Gaza City]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2025/10/3/live-israel-blows-up-gaza-city-homes-as-palestinians-ordered-to-flee (Al Jazeera)]
**[[Israeli blockade of the Gaza Strip (2023–present)|Israeli blockade of the Gaza Strip]], [[Gaza genocide]], [[Humanitarian aid during the Gaza war]]
***The [[Israeli Navy]] intercepts and seizes the [[Poland|Polish]]-flagged ''Marinette'', the last vessel of the [[Global Sumud Flotilla]], an international humanitarian [[flotilla]] seeking to break the [[Gaza blockade]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2025/10/3/israel-dismantles-gaza-humanitarian-flotilla-but-one-boat-sails (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Somali Civil War]]
**[[2025 Shabelle offensive]]
***With [[Uganda|Ugandan]] support, the [[Somali National Army]] and other pro-federal forces reportedly recapture two villages from [[Al-Shabaab (militant group)|al-Shabaab]]. Government sources claim that al-Shabaab's forces suffered heavy casualties from the fighting. [https://sonna.so/en/somali-national-army-aussom-forces-liberate-two-villages-in-lower-shabelle/ (Somali National News Agency)]
*[[War on drugs]], [[2025 US Caribbean naval deployment]]
**[[2025 United States strikes on Venezuelan boats]]
***The [[United States Navy]] conducts a strike targeting an alleged drug smuggling boat in the [[Venezuelan]] coast. According to [[U.S. defense secretary]] [[Pete Hegseth]], at least four crewmembers were killed in the attack. [https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/us-carries-out-new-strike-against-alleged-drug-vessel-near-venezuela-2025-10-03/ (Reuters)]
*[[Boko Haram insurgency]]
**More than 5,000 people flee from [[Borno State]], [[Nigeria]], to [[Cameroon]] after [[Boko Haram]] fighters seize [[Cameroon–Nigeria border|the border]] town of Kirawa and burn multiple buildings. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/thousands-flee-cameroon-boko-haram-seizes-nigerian-border-town-2025-10-03/ (Reuters)]
*[[Insurgency in Balochistan]]
**Seven terrorists are killed and a huge cache of weapons and ammunition is recovered in an operation by security forces in [[Sherani District]], [[Balochistan, Pakistan|Balochistan]], [[Pakistan]]. [https://english.news.cn/asiapacific/20251003/a9064c0a9a8e4fbfa129993b3f8bcfa7/c.html (Xinhua News Agency)]
*[[Russo-Ukrainian war (2022–present)|Russo-Ukrainian war]]
**[[List of journalists killed during the Russo-Ukrainian War]]
***[[French people|French]] journalist [[Antoni Lallican]] is killed and photographer Hryhoriy Ivanchenko is injured by a [[Russia]]n [[Drone warfare|drone strike]] in [[Donetsk Oblast]], [[Ukraine]]. [https://www.rferl.org/a/french-journalist-killed-ukraine-lallican-drone-attack/33549080.html (RFE/RL)]

'''Arts and culture'''
*[[Bishop of London]] [[Sarah Mullally]] is announced as the new [[archbishop of Canterbury]], becoming the first woman to lead the [[Church of England]] and the [[Anglican Communion]]. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/live/c0r0201jgdlt (BBC News)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*Five people are killed after an overcrowded vehicle overturns on [[Japan National Route 165|NR-165]] in [[Nabari]], [[Mie Prefecture]], [[Japan]]. [https://english.kyodonews.net/articles/-/62079 (Kyodo News)]
*At least three people drown after catastrophic flash floods hit the southern [[Black Sea]] coast of [[Bulgaria]]. [https://www.novinite.com/articles/234733/Absolute+Tragedy+in+Bulgaria%3A+Three+Dead+in+Elenite+Floods%2C+Including+Border+Policeman (Novinite.com)]
*At least two people are killed and others are injured when an [[Iranian Red Crescent Society]] [[Air medical services|rescue helicopter]] carrying nine people crashes in [[Lorestan province]], [[Iran]]. [https://en.mehrnews.com/news/237295/A-rescue-helicopter-crashes-in-Iran-s-Lorestan-kills-2 (Mehr News Agency)]

'''International relations'''
*[[China–India relations]], [[Sino–Indian border dispute]]
**[[India]]n airline [[IndiGo]] announces it will resume direct flights between [[Kolkata]] and [[Guangzhou]], [[China]], on October 26, launching the first direct flights between the two countries since [[2020–2021 China–India skirmishes|border skirmishes in 2020]]. [https://www.dw.com/en/india-china-to-resume-direct-flights/a-74231042 (DW)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Capital punishment in Tunisia]], [[Decree Law 54 (Tunisia)|Decree Law 54]]
**A court in [[Nabeul]], [[Tunisia]], sentences a 56-year-old man to death over online statements criticizing [[President of Tunisia|President]] [[Kais Saied]] and state security agencies. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/tunisian-sentenced-death-facebook-posts-criticising-president-2025-10-03/ (Reuters)]
*[[Trial of Sean Combs]]
**A court in [[Manhattan]], [[New York (state)|New York]], [[United States]], sentences musician [[Sean Combs]] to four years and two months in [[Incarceration in the United States|prison]] for [[Prostitution in the United States|prostitution]]-related charges. [https://www.bbc.com/news/live/ckge0zgppzet (BBC News)]
*The [[Bangkok]] [[Criminal Court of Thailand|Criminal Court]] sentences a [[Thailand|Thai]] man to [[life in prison]] for the January 7 assassination of [[Cambodia]]n politician [[Lim Kimya]] in Bangkok. [https://apnews.com/article/thailand-cambodia-opposition-politician-killing-017f88adea30e786cfc73f941f74fb3b (AP)]
*A [[Finland|Finnish]] [[Judicial system of Finland|court]] dismisses charges against the crew of the ''[[Eagle S]]'' tanker, ruling prosecutors failed to prove intent in the [[2024 Estlink 2 incident]] and that negligence must be addressed by [[Cook Islands|the ship's flag state]] or crew's home countries. [https://www.reuters.com/business/media-telecom/finnish-court-deliver-verdict-baltic-sea-cable-breach-trial-against-tanker-crew-2025-10-03/ (Reuters)]
*A court in [[Yerevan]], [[Armenia]] sentences Mikael Ajapahyan, a prominent cleric of the [[Armenian Apostolic Church]], to two years in prison for allegedly calling for the overthrow of [[Prime Minister of Armenia|Prime Minister]] [[Nikol Pashinyan]]. [https://apnews.com/article/armenia-church-cleric-pashinyan-opposition-prison-9a6db260de55857751aac6701c9a0077 (AP)]
*At least two people are killed and five others are injured in a [[mass shooting]] in Les Moulins near [[Nice]], [[Alpes-Maritimes]], [[Provence-Alpes-Côte d'Azur]], [[France]]. [https://www.lefigaro.fr/nice/nice-au-moins-deux-morts-et-cinq-blesses-dans-une-fusillade-dans-le-quartier-des-moulins-20251003 (''Le Figaro'')] [https://www.timesnownews.com/world/europe/shooting-in-nice-multiple-dead-several-injured-in-les-moulins-neighbourhood-article-152937274 (Times Now)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2025 Czech parliamentary election]]
**[[Czechs]] vote to elect the members of the [[Chamber of Deputies of the Czech Republic|Chamber of Deputies]]. For the first time, Czechs living or stationed abroad can [[Postal voting|vote via mail]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/czechs-vote-frontrunner-babis-promises-lavish-spending-less-ukraine-support-2025-10-02/ (Reuters)]
*[[2025 Indonesian protests]]
**[[Indonesia]] suspends [[TikTok]]'s registration as an electronic service provider after the company fails to submit complete data on its [[live streaming]] activity during nationwide protests. [https://www.reuters.com/sustainability/boards-policy-regulation/indonesia-suspends-tiktok-registration-over-data-sharing-failures-ministry-says-2025-10-03/ (Reuters)]
*[[2025 Maldivian protests]]
**[[Maldives Police Service|Police]] violently crack down on and arrest eight people during an overnight protest against [[Government of the Maldives|government]] [[Corruption in the Maldives|corruption]] in [[Malé]] in the [[Maldives]]. [https://apnews.com/article/maldives-protest-arrests-maldivian-democratic-party-25561cac2009c3a2fe0ef3758fe42229 (AP)] [https://raajje.mv/171487 (Raajje TV)]
*[[Abdication of Henri, Grand Duke of Luxembourg]]
**[[Henri, Grand Duke of Luxembourg|Henri]], the [[Monarchy of Luxembourg|grand duke of Luxembourg]], [[Abdication|abdicates]] and is succeeded by his eldest son, [[Guillaume V, Grand Duke of Luxembourg|Guillaume V]]. [https://www.ft.com/content/b4c9e21f-1beb-41ce-ad04-007c40f67728 (''Financial Times'')]
*[[Lithuania]]n [[Ministry of Culture (Lithuania)|culture minister]] [[Ignotas Adomavičius]] resigns after one week in office amidst protests. [https://www.lrt.lt/en/news-in-english/19/2700570/lithuanian-culture-minister-resigns-after-one-week-in-office-amid-backlash (LRT)]
